_note: FL20 draft: shipped block notes that the code contradicts (prologue and South Cape). Every block note is a full-text replacement (the spec format has no partial edit). Apply in the apply pass (plan section 7) after a fresh extract:lt. All facts are read from the extracted actor code of the named file; flag values are hex, waits are in ticks.

blockNote: South Cape fisherman NPC on the south shore, with the strange pot.

At spawn one RNG byte picks the layout: below $C8 he stands at tile (06,2F) and says 'Gosh. I can't pull it up...'; $C8-$EF puts him at tile (0B,33), mirrored, with 'Even if I move to another place I can't pull it up...'; $F0 and above puts him at tile (29,30) beside the pot actor e_sc01_pot ('He lifted the strange teapot.'), unless flag $D7 is set, in which case the second layout is used.

The pot's interact handler gives item $01 (Red Jewel) once, prints 'You've found a Red Jewel!' and sets flag $D7. A full inventory jumps to hidden_red_jewel.HiddenRedJewelInventoryFull before the flag is set.

Every pass the fisherman writes scratch flag $00: set while the player's Y position is $0250 or more, clear otherwise. The player idle-sprite code in player_character reads the same flag. Scratch flags $00-$0F are cleared at every scene load.
South Cape NPC who mentions the approaching star.
No flags. One interact handler prints one dialog ('a star is approaching the Earth'). The actor walks a fixed route in three legs with a wait of $EF ticks before each, then stays at the last stop.
South Cape traveling weapon salesman NPC.

No flags. After a first wait of $EF ticks he walks a fixed route with four stops of $78 ticks each. The interact handler prints 'I won't sell a weapon to a child' (code_0482CD) until the walk ends; the actor then switches the handler to code_0482D2 ('Salesman: Hmmm...') and stands solid.
South Cape woman worried about strange merchants.

No flags. One interact handler prints the worried line. The actor waits $B3 and $77 ticks, then after a delay of $053C ticks walks a route out and back, standing solid for $EF ticks at the far stop, and redraws the metatile at tiles (2C,0E) and (1C,0E) between $F8 and $F9 as she leaves and returns.
South Cape house narration actor.

Each frame the actor tests the player position with BranchIfPlayerAt (exact pixel match): Will's door at X $0208, Y $00E0 or $00DF; Lance's door at ($0128,$0258); Erik's doors at ($0228,$0218) and ($0218,$0178); the cave-exit tile at ($0298,$02C0). The house is chosen by that position; the flags are once-latches.

Will's door: flag $12 clear prints 'This is my house' and sets $12; the door then queues scene $06 at ($0058,$01C0). With $21 set and $26 clear the narration is skipped and the scene change runs directly. Lance's door: $13 latch ('This is Lance's house'). Erik's doors: $14 latch ('My friend Erik lives here'). Cave-exit tile: with $16 set and $17 clear the actor sets $17, locks the joypad ($CFFC), waits $1D ticks, prints 'It was already dark by the time Will left the cave' and unlocks.
The block code_04BCCA repeats Will's door test and has no reference.
South Cape school teacher (Priest) who gives the opening narration.

At spawn the actor stands solid with the interact handler code_048AD9 (flag $21 clear: 'Please recite with me'; set: 'What is it, Will?'). With flag $10 clear it locks the joypad ($CFFC), waits $1D ticks, prints Will's monologue, waits $3B ticks, plays six sound pairs $1E ticks apart, prints the lesson ('That's all for today's lesson'), waits $3B ticks and sets $10. That is the only flag it sets; sc08_erik releases the joypad lock after its walk. With $10 set at load the lesson is skipped and the joypad stays free; Lance, Erik and Seth die at spawn.
Edward Castle soldier who arrests Kara in Will's house.

Cutscene actor. At spawn flag $1B set kills it; otherwise it waits for scratch flag $04 (Lola's line), takes tile (0A,19) and watches for the player inside tiles (04,19)-(0E,1D). On entry it locks the joypad ($CFFC), waits $1D ticks, steps in, prints the soldier and Kara exchange, sets scratch $07 and waits for scratch $08 (Kara's reply), then walks off and dies. It sets no persistent flag: sc06_kara sets $1B, and sc06_bill releases the joypad lock.
Coastal cave card pickup (the Ace of Diamonds trick).

The scene places one card at tile (07,0A); it runs the entry code_04AFB5 (sprite priority $30, a nudge of (8,0), then idles). Lance spawns four more cards at code_04AFBF (SpawnAfterOffsetFlags in sc02_lance). Each of those stages sprite and hitbox $38 and tests every frame whether the player's position (plus 8 in X and $0A in Y) is within 8 pixels of the card in both axes and the button mask $8001 is pressed. Pressing it prints 'Will picks up a card. It is the Ace of Diamonds, of course!', sets scratch flag $08, locks the joypad ($CFFC) and kills the card; sc02_lance releases the lock. A card out of reach switches to an idle entry once $08 is set. No item is given.
Lance in the coastal cave -- card game and statue chain.

At spawn flag $4C set kills the actor; flag $20 or $16 set selects an idle state with the interact handlers code_04B1A0 ($25 set: 'You look so gloomy'; $1C set: 'It's a day off from school'; otherwise 'One more game with Seth and I'm going home').

Otherwise the first talk sets scratch $01 and prints 'What is it, Will? ... Wait a minute.' After Erik's news (scratch $03 set and cleared) Lance waits for scratch $05 (Seth's 'Everyone's here'; Lance then hints 'Draw it to you by spinning the Flute around like a baton'), scratch $06 (the statue moved) and scratch $07 (Will talks to Lance again). Then he locks the joypad ($CFFC), spawns four sc02_card actors, prints 'Pick the one you think is the Ace of Diamonds', unlocks and waits for scratch $08 (a card picked), prints 'Ahhh! Right!!', waits for scratch $0A (Seth's explanation), prints two lines, sets scratch $0B, clears scratch $04 (which frees the cave exit) and releases the joypad lock.
Prologue palette thinkers.

Two palette-bundle thinkers: e_pr_thinker_0BD031 starts bundle $75, steps once and kills itself; e_pr_thinker_0BD039 starts bundle $76, steps once, sets scratch flag $0F and kills itself. e_pr_thinker_0BD039 is spawned in scenes $8C-$8F; no actor of those scenes reads $0F.
